serverInfo.name: Google-AgentEditor
serverInfo.title: Google Agent Editor
serverInfo.description: Author, validate, and deploy complex Gemini Agent JSON drafts stored in the user's OneDrive.

instructions: Maintain one validated agent.json document per draft under /google-agents/{draftName}/agent.json in the user's default OneDrive. Use focused scalar, source, environment, network, function, search, and MCP-server tools rather than raw JSON parameters. Inspect before deployment. Deployment posts the validated draft to Google but leaves the OneDrive draft unchanged.
